definitions.explanation: the tendency to forget things, often due to age, distraction, or poor memory

FORMS:
⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (things) + ⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (forgetting) → forgetting things

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦うっかり{忘|わす}れ→うっかり忘れ：08977_ukkariwasure⟧ (careless forgetfulness)
- ⟦{記憶力|きおくりょく}→記憶力：17616_kiokuryoku⟧ (memory capacity)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物忘|ものわす}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ (to be very forgetful)

Severe or worsening {物忘|ものわす}れ in older adults may be a sign of dementia and should be evaluated by a doctor.
